capabilities: Cycle screenplay line types with Tab or Shift+Tab
Render scene, shot, action, character, parenthetical and dialogue elements as Markdown
Show a transient badge naming the current line type
Renumber scenes from the command palette
Export to Word, PDF, HTML or plain text
extras: Not in the community catalog yet; install manually or through BRAT. PDF export uses Obsidian's built-in exporter, while .docx, .html and .txt export need a pandoc path set in settings. Editor line styling avoids margin, text-align and text-indent because they misplace click targets; true centering works only in reading view. The English UI has not been checked in-app yet.
intentEvidence: Most screenplay plugins render their own format (Fountain and friends)
problem: Screenplay plugins that use their own markup leave notes full of symbols that only render inside the plugin.

relations.evidence: Most screenplay plugins render their own format (Fountain and friends)

summary: Screenplay writing workflow that cycles line types with Tab and stores each element as plain Markdown for export.
